Name: M 97 - Meenakshi Srinivasan, City Planning Commission.
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE MAYOR OF MEENAKSHI SRINIVASAN AS A MEMBER OF THE NEW YORK CITY PLANNING COMMISSION.
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text: RESOLVED, Pursuant to Sections 31 and 192 of the New York City Charter, the Council hereby approves the appointment by the Mayor of Meenakshi Srinivasan as a member of the New York City Planning Commission to serve the remainder of a five-year term that will expire on June 30, 2031.
